s.d: causative action by which humans or deities cause (other) humans or animals to be located in a place that is at a relatively great distance from the point of reference
s.g: to put far away; to remove

s.d: literally: to be far off; hence: = state in which an event is in the distant future
literally: to be far (from someone else); hence: = state in which humans or deities are no longer associating with (other) humans or deities, ◄ as if they have distanced themselves
literally: to cause to be far (from someone else); hence: = causative action by which deities cause humans to stop associating with (other) humans, ◄ as if they have distanced themselves
literally: to be far (from an event); hence: = state in which humans are not able to engage in a certain event, ◄ as if the event has distanced itself from them
literally: to put (an event) far (from someone else); hence: = action by which humans do not engage in a certain event, ◄ as if they have distanced the event from reality
literally: to stay far (from an event); hence: = action by which humans do not engage in a certain event, ◄ as if they have distanced themselves from the event

literally: to put (an event) far (from someone else); hence: = causative action by which deities or circumstances cause humans not to engage in a certain event, ◄ as if they have distanced the event from them
literally: to put (one's) palms far (from someone else); hence: = causative action by which deities release their control of someone else
s.g: to withdraw (one's) hands (from someone); to stop punishing

s.d: literally: to put (someone's) sins far (from that person); hence: = action by which deities fully forgive someone's sins and shortcomings ◄ as if by moving them to a distant place
literally: to cause ends or boundaries to be far; hence: = causative action by which deities enlarge a territory ◄ by extending its boundaries
literally: to put (one's) heart far (from a deity); hence: = action by which humans refuse to think or take notice of a certain deity
literally: far (from someone else); hence: = state in which humans are no longer devoted to a certain deity, ◄ as if they have distanced themselves
literally: (one's) heart is astir with words; hence: = process by which the human mind is busy thinking about what to say

wooden implement with a long, flat blade attached to a long handle, ► for throwing threshed grain into the air so that the wind might separate the straw and chaff from the grain; ≈ winnowing is often used as a figure of speech to denote the process of distinguishing between good and bad
process by which the body of humans is partially or fully covered with liquid, ◄ as a result of rain or dew
state in which a plant grows and develops well ◄ as a result of having adequate access to water; ≈ used to denote humans who are enjoying prosperity for a time
state/process by which humans shake or tremble violently and involuntarily, ◄ caused by fear
meaning unsure; possibly: = state in which the human body is as healthy as that of a young child
s.g: to be fresh; to be healthy

s.d: causative action by which humans end the life of other humans with brutal violence, using sharp implements such as knives, swords, and arrows
a liquid substance
action by which humans initiate a possible argument or conflict with other humans or with a deity by accusing them of wrongdoing or by taking action in a different way
s.g: to quarrel; to contend; to accuse

s.d: exact meaning is not clear but likely = action by which a person or deity initiates a conflict with someone, accusing that person of wrongdoing and resulting in a consequence or punishment
participle = someone who is in conflict with or opposes a person, usually involving a legal or ethical dispute
action by which humans or deities resolve a conflict for their own benefit or for the benefit of (other) humans who may not be in a position to do that for themselves
s.g: to plead (another's cause); to defend; to take up (another's) cause

s.d: exact meaning is not at all clear but possibly = action by which a person or deity accuses or files a legal complaint against someone; but see also {L:רִיב<SDBH:רִיב>}
s.g: to contend against; to bring charges against

s.d: state of opposition or hostility between two or more persons, perhaps even involving a deity
s.g: dispute; quarrel; strife; argument; (law)suit; case; indictment

s.d: literally: person of contention; therefore = someone who is in contention with or opposes a person or deity, usually involving a legal or ethical dispute
state of opposition or hostility between two or more persons, perhaps even involving a deity
s.g: dispute; quarrel; strife; argument; (law)suit; case; indictment

s.d: action by which humans argue their case before a judge
man; ► father of {L:Ithai<SDBH:אִיתַי>}, {L:Ittai<SDBH:אִתַּי>}, warrior; time of {L:David<SDBH:דָּוִד>}
a distinctive smell, which can be perceived as either pleasant or unpleasant; ≈ sometimes associated with the attitude a certain smell evokes in those who perceive it

literally: to cause (someone's) {L:odor<SDBH:רֵיחַ>} to give off a bad smell in the eyes of someone else; hence: = process by which humans cause other humans to become repulsive or loathsome in the eyes of someone else ◄ as a result of antagonistic actions ► resulting in enmity between the parties involved
literally: scent of water; hence: = state in which water is nearby
s.g: scent of water > presence of water

s.d: exact meaning unknown; probably: = unprocessed grain kernels
causative action by which humans empty out a container holding liquids, dry substances, or other objects
causative action by which humans draw their sword from its sheath
literally: to pour out; hence: = action by which humans select people from a group for a certain purpose
literally: to empty itself out; hence: = process by which liquids flow from a storage area
s.g: to pour out; to discharge; to feed

s.d: literally: to leave (someone's) throat empty; hence: = causative action by which humans fail to provide food for the hungry
state in which a container does not contain anything
literally: empty; hence: = state in which an event does not serve a useful purpose and is bound to fail
state in which a container does not contain anything
literally: empty; hence: = state in which humans have lost their possessions
s.g: to be emptied out; to be stripped (of one's possession)

s.d: literally: empty; hence: = state in which words or actions have no purpose
literally: empty throat; hence: = state in which humans are in need of food
state in which humans live as if they have no useful purpose in life, as a result of which they are not respected by others
state in which a container does not contain anything
literally: empty; hence: = state in which an object is returned without an accompanying gift
literally: empty; hence: = action by which someone performs an event without any argument, cause, or reason that could possibly explain or justify it
literally: empty; = process by which people, tools, and events fail to reach their intended goal
literally: empty; hence: = state in which humans have lost their possessions
process by which a slimy discharge flows from the human body
s.g: to flow; to secrete; to discharge

s.d: a slimy liquid produced by plants or the human body
state in which humans lack sufficient means to live at a standard that is considered normal; ≈ sometimes associated with laziness or foolishness, but ultimately determined by God
literally: soft of heart; hence: = state in which humans lack courage and decisiveness
literally: soft; hence: = state in which the human body or part of the body is very fine in texture or structure, which is associated with beauty
literally: soft; hence: = state in which humans are relatively unexperienced in a certain area
literally: soft; hence: = state in which events take place with the intention to avoid conflicts and promote peace
literally: soft; hence: = state in which humans are very mild-mannered in their interaction with others
literally: soft; hence: = state in which substances are in a relatively early stage of development
literally: soft; hence: = state in which parts of the human body do not function as well as expected
literally: soft; hence: = state in which humans lack strength because of young age
literally: softness; hence: = state in which humans are very mild-mannered in their interaction with others
action by which humans ride on a domestic animal such as a {L:donkey<SDBH:חֲמֹור>} or a {L:horse<SDBH:סוּס>} or in a {L:chariot<SDBH:מֶרְכָּבָה>}

causative action by which humans or deities make (other) humans ride on a domestic animal such as a {L:donkey<SDBH:חֲמֹור>} or a {L:horse<SDBH:סוּס>}, in a {L:chariot<SDBH:מֶרְכָּבָה>} or on a {L:cart<SDBH:עֲגָלָה>}
causative action by which humans harness an animal to a chariot or plow in order to draw it
s.g: to make pull; to make draw

s.d: literally: to make one's hands ride; hence, probably: = causative action by which humans let their hands move over an object; ≈ possibly as a ritual of consecration
man; ◄ son of {L:Rimmon<SDBH:רִמֹּון>}; ► murderer of king {L:Ishbosheth<SDBH:אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת>}
man; ► father of {L:Jehonadab<SDBH:יְהֹונָדָב>}; ancestor of the {L:Rechabites<SDBH:רֵכָבִי>}
man; ► father of {L:Malchijah<SDBH:מַלְכִּיָּה>}, ruler of district; time of {L:Nehemiah<SDBH:נְחֶמְיָה>}

upper stone of two stones ► that are used to grind grain into flour; the grain was placed on the stationary bottom stone, and the top stone was pressed down on top of the grain and scraped back and forth
open vehicle with two or four wheels, pulled by one or more horses; ◄ made of wood and iron; ► used in war or for travelling
a group of {L:chariots<SDBH:מֶרְכָּבָה>}, usually owned by one single person
horses ► used for pulling chariots
people ► riding a {L:horse<SDBH:סוּס>} or {L:donkey<SDBH:חֲמֹור>}
person riding on a {L:horse<SDBH:סוּס>} or driving a {L:chariot<SDBH:מֶרְכָּבָה>}
action by which humans ride on a domestic animal such as a {L:donkey<SDBH:חֲמֹור>} or a {L:horse<SDBH:סוּס>} or in a {L:chariot<SDBH:מֶרְכָּבָה>}

descendant of {L:Rechab<SDBH:רֵכָב>}, a group of people who refused to live a sedentary life as farmers as the other {L:Israelites<SDBH:יִשְׂרָאֵל>}, but continued to live in tents and were not allowed to drink wine
town; ◄ territory of {L:Judah<SDBH:יְהוּדָה>}
open vehicle with two or four wheels, pulled by one or more horses; ◄ made of wood and iron; ► used in war or for travelling
objects of value that one has acquired, such as livestock and material goods
man; ◄ son of {L:Heman<SDBH:הֵימָן>}; ► temple singer; time of king {L:David<SDBH:דָּוִד>}
process by which structures shake involuntarily ◄ as a result of divine intervention
s.g: to tremble; to quake; to shake
